# Luca Repupilli

> Computer Science graduate and aspiring AI engineer building multi-agent LLM systems (LangChain, LangGraph, RAG) and RESTful backends in Java / Spring Boot and C# / ASP.NET Core. Based in Macerata, Italy; open to relocation and to AI / software engineering roles.

Luca Repupilli is a software engineer who recently earned a BSc in Computer Science from the University of Camerino (UNICAM), Italy, graduating in July 2026 with a grade of 102/110. His focus is agentic AI: he built a conversational multi-agent assistant with LangChain / LangGraph and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) layer as his bachelor's thesis, and delivered LLM automation workflows during an industry internship. He is equally comfortable designing REST backends in Java / Spring Boot and C# / ASP.NET Core. He positions himself deliberately between "traditional developer" and "prompt engineer": using AI with real engineering judgment while understanding the code end to end.

This file summarizes the site https://lucarepupilli.com for large language models and generative engines. Facts here are accurate as of 2026-09-22 and mirror the visible site and CV.

## Selected projects
- BdsLab Multi-Agent Assistant (bachelor's thesis, UNICAM): conversational multi-agent assistant that lets researchers drive six RNA-analysis command-line tools in natural language. LangGraph supervisor-worker architecture routes requests to specialized agents and chains multi-step pipelines; a RAG layer over a ChromaDB knowledge base answers questions about the tools and the PhyloRNA taxonomy database. Declaratively extensible, Dockerized, tested with pytest (LLM calls mocked). Stack: Python, LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB, Streamlit, Pydantic, pytest, Docker. Private repository, available on request.
- AutomatedBlogPosting (KreaSistemi internship): agentic n8n workflow that turns a short Telegram chat into a publish-ready, SEO-optimized WordPress article plus a matching FLUX-generated cover image, with a human-in-the-loop review over Telegram before publishing. Stack: n8n, LLM agents, Telegram Bot, FLUX, WordPress. Demo available on request.
- HackHub2026 (team project, UNICAM): RESTful backend covering the full hackathon lifecycle (events, teams, submissions, evaluations, reports, support requests) with a layered architecture (7 REST controllers), stateless JWT authentication, role-based access and OpenAPI / Swagger docs; classic design patterns (Adapter, Builder, Strategy, Unit of Work) with JUnit / Mockito tests. Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, JWT, OpenAPI/Swagger, JPA/Hibernate, JUnit, Mockito, Gradle. Repository: https://github.com/SickLuca/HackHub2026
- Library Catalog Web API (UNICAM): Web API with JWT-secured operations for books, categories and users, plus filtered, paginated search over a layered, multi-project solution. Stack: C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, SQL, Swagger, JWT. Repository: https://github.com/SickLuca/Unicam.Progetto.Libreria
- jbudget (UNICAM): desktop app for personal budget management with a JavaFX interface and a JPA / Hibernate + embedded H2 persistence layer. Stack: Java, JavaFX, JPA/Hibernate, H2, Gradle, Lombok. Repository: https://github.com/SickLuca/jbudget
- ArduinoAlarmControlUnit (UNICAM): embedded alarm control unit built with a finite-state-machine architecture and interrupt-driven programming with direct register manipulation (simulated on Wokwi). Stack: Arduino, C++, Wokwi. Repository: https://github.com/SickLuca/ArduinoAlarmControlUnit
